## Overview & Philosophy

NotchDock is a lightweight macOS desktop utility built natively for macOS (Monterey 12.0+). It transforms the MacBook camera hardware notch into an ambient live activity center and silent notification tray for real-time sports scores, intraday stock tickers, meeting countdowns, clipboard history, and universal media controls.

### How It Works
- **Ambient Micro-Updates**: Subtle pulse dots and text tickers render directly in the black camera cutout bezel without noisy chime alerts or sliding banners.
- **Hover Detection**: Detects cursor movement in proximity to the screen notch area to smoothly expand the full interactive status dock.
- **Zero Distraction**: Runs silently in the background without stealing window focus, breaking full-screen apps, or interrupting video presentations.
- **100% On-Device Privacy**: Operates entirely locally. No clipboard contents, stock watchlists, notes, or user telemetry ever leave the machine.

---

## Why NotchDock — Core Differentiators
- **URL**: https://notchdock.app/why-notchdock.html
- **Summary**: Comprehensive explanation of NotchDock's product philosophy and ambient design principles.
- **Key Differentiators**:
  1. **Intelligent Ambient Notifications vs Banner Fatigue**: Replaces disruptive top-right banners with silent, glanceable status indicators in the camera notch.
  2. **Hardware Dead Space Reclaimed**: Transforms static camera bezel pixels into an active, hover-activated productivity surface.
  3. **Zero Menu Bar & Screen Clutter**: Replaces dozens of menu bar icons and floating desktop widgets with a single consolidated tray.
  4. **100% On-Device & Private**: Zero cloud telemetry, no accounts required, and zero network tracking.

---

## Notch App Comparison Hub (NotchDock vs Alternatives)
- **URL**: https://notchdock.app/compare/mac-notch-apps.html
- **Summary**: Direct comparison of top macOS notch utilities in 2026: NotchDock, NotchNook, Boring Notch, Seam, and Alcove.
- **Comparison Key Points**:
  - **NotchDock**: Freemium utility; features intelligent live sports scoreboards (NFL, EPL, NBA, MLB), real-time stock watchlists with sparkline charts, clipboard history manager, and 100% local privacy.
  - **NotchNook**: $25 paid license; offers iPad-style file drop shelf and basic media player controls.
  - **Boring Notch**: Free open-source; minimalist music visualizer focused solely on media playback.
  - **Seam / Alcove**: Freemium/paid utilities offering dynamic island status indicators and quick toggles.

## Feature Details

### 1. Silent Notch Notifications
- **URL**: https://notchdock.app/features/silent-notch-notifications.html
- **Summary**: Ambient status indicators replacing intrusive system banner alerts.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Glow pulse dots and subtle text marquees integrated directly into the black notch bezel.
  - Displays background status (renders, meeting countdowns, active timers, live match minutes).
  - Keeps workflow focused and free from banner spam.

### 2. Live Sports Score Tracker
- **URL**: https://notchdock.app/features/mac-sports-tracker.html
- **Summary**: Displays live scores, match minutes, and game stats directly underneath the MacBook notch.
- **Supported Leagues**: NFL, Premier League (EPL), UEFA Champions League, NBA, MLB, NHL, and FIFA World Cup.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Auto-refreshing score updates without desktop notification popups.
  - Team pin capability to follow favorite clubs or teams.
  - Micro sparkline graphics showing match momentum and time remaining.

### 3. Mac Stock Portfolio & Crypto Tracker
- **URL**: https://notchdock.app/features/mac-stock-portfolio.html
- **Summary**: Real-time market ticker and watchlist for stock market indices, individual equities, and cryptocurrencies.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Live prices for S&P 500, Nasdaq, Dow Jones, and major crypto assets (BTC, ETH, SOL).
  - Intraday sparkline charts visible on hover.
  - Customizable watchlist with price alerts displayed inside the camera bezel notch.

### 4. Mac Clipboard Manager
- **URL**: https://notchdock.app/features/mac-clipboard-manager.html
- **Summary**: Instant history tray for copied text, links, image previews, and code snippets.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - One-click copy/paste from the notch tray.
  - Searchable history buffer with persistent local storage.
  - Privacy safeguards: Sensitive strings (passwords, auth tokens) can be automatically excluded.

### 5. Mac Media Controller
- **URL**: https://notchdock.app/features/mac-media-controller.html
- **Summary**: Universal media playback widget embedded into the notch tray.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Album art display, track title, artist name, and progress timeline.
  - Play, pause, skip, and volume adjustment without switching active applications.
  - Supports Apple Music, Spotify, YouTube, Web Browsers, and system-level audio feeds.

### 6. Mac Pomodoro & Quick Notes
- **URL**: https://notchdock.app/features/mac-pomodoro-notes.html
- **Summary**: Integrated focus timer and scratchpad for fast task tracking.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Customizable focus sessions (25 min work, 5 min break) with subtle visual notch countdown.
  - Drag-and-drop task reordering.
  - Persistent quick notes scratchpad for fast thoughts and meeting takeaways.

---

## System Requirements & Installation

- **macOS Version**: macOS 12.0 (Monterey), macOS 13.0 (Ventura), macOS 14.0 (Sonoma), macOS 15.0 (Sequoia) or newer.
- **Hardware Support**: Compatible with Apple Silicon (M1, M2, M3, M4) MacBooks (MacBook Pro 14"/16", MacBook Air 13"/15") as well as Intel-based Macs.
- **Permissions**: Requires standard macOS Accessibility permission in System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> Accessibility to track cursor position near screen edges.

### Installation Instructions
1. Download `NotchDock.dmg` from the GitHub Releases page.
2. Mount the DMG image and drag `NotchDock.app` into `/Applications`.
3. Open `NotchDock.app`. On first launch, follow the prompt to enable Accessibility access in macOS System Settings.
4. Hover near the notch area to activate the dock.

---

## Privacy & Security Policy

- **Local-Only Execution**: NotchDock does not collect, track, or transmit any user data.
- **Clipboard Safety**: Copy-paste buffer items are stored locally in application sandbox memory and are never uploaded anywhere.
- **Network Requests**: The only outgoing network requests are direct API fetches for user-requested public data (such as live sports scores or stock market tickers) and checking for app updates via the public Appcast feed.
